baseline.note: No shared baseline fits: baseline-gsplat-deblurnerf-40000 uses the original Deblur-NeRF COLMAP points (fewer points; cake 6655 vs 14465, ball 1867 vs 9944) and 40k steps. Paper's 3D-GS row (vanilla 3DGS on blurry inputs): cake 20.16, caps 19.08, ball 22.99, girl 19.72.

paper_reference.source: Table 1 (real defocus), Table 2 (real camera motion), supp. LPIPS tables

data_status: All 20 real scenes built (authors' release deblur_dataset.zip, /bigdata/sejain/datasets/deblurring3dgs, symlink ~/datasets/deblurring3dgs) and registered in tools/datasets.json as deblur3dgs-defocus / deblur3dgs-motion (native-defocus/<scene>, native-motion/<scene>).
cost: 2000-step smoke ~110 s on a shared A6000 (<0.5 GB); expect ~20-30 min per 20k run (more Gaussians after 2500), motion 5 renders/step.
notes: Headline = ss-eval test PSNR (sharp render, black background) at 20000 steps vs paper per-scene PSNR. SSIM/LPIPS implementations differ from the paper's Deblur-NeRF metrics (skimage SSIM, LPIPS-Alex). Single seed.
